aboutShort: A trusted B2B pharmaceutical exporter and wholesale supplier of authentic brand-name, generic, specialty, and veterinary medicines to international markets.

aboutFull.intro: 4 Core Exim is a premier global pharmaceutical exporter based in India. We are dedicated to providing high-quality, authentic WHO-GMP certified life-saving drugs, oncology treatments, vaccines, veterinary products, and OTC formulations to international wholesale buyers, clinics, and government supply bodies.
aboutFull.sourcing: Leveraging deep relationships with India's leading manufacturers (including Cipla, Sun Pharma, Healing Pharma, Abbott, Zydus, and others), we guarantee genuine medicines procured through official and audited supply lines.
aboutFull.supplyChain: Our operations feature temp-controlled warehousing and strict cold-chain maintenance for sensitive biologicals. From packaging verification to air/ocean freight booking, we maintain product integrity at every node.
aboutFull.compliance: We provide comprehensive regulatory documentation including Certificates of Analysis (CoA), GMP certification copies, product dossiers, and customizable labeling to ensure smooth custom clearance in importing nations.
